Hi Emma (and Alicia),

Thanks again for interviewing with Redwood — excited to move you into a virtual onsite for the Senior LLM Infra Engineer role. Below is the proposed compact 4-slot flow for Wednesday June 7th (all Pacific Time):

- 10:00 - 10:35 — System Design (Jonas)
- 10:45 - 11:20 — Model Serving + Ops (Marissa)
- 11:50 - 12:20 — Team Fit / Collaboration (Kimberly)
- 13:30 - 14:00 — Leadership + Roadmap (Laura)

We left a 30-minute lunch buffer and small gaps for overruns. If any slot is tight for you, let me know and we can swap the order.

Logistics: all interviews will be on Zoom (links in the calendar invites attached). Please upload a short code sample or design sketch to the HireFlow candidate page before Monday EOD — that'll help interviewers prep.

Attachments: calendar invites, candidate brief, scorecard template (for internal reviewers).

Would you mind confirming the day/time works? Also copying Alicia from TalentBridge to coordinate travel/comp issues.

Best,
Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Recruiting Manager, Redwood Inference

- Keep system design focused on latency/cost tradeoffs — ask candidate to sketch a short 10-minute architecture and then deep-dive.

- Team fit should cover cross-team comp and on-call experience.
